why: The horizontal distances in the component and Smart sources that scripts/lint-spacing-roles.mjs finds off the role table of the geometry standard (C105, C144; C178 every general rule checked in the pair build), on group build 4 (09cf1b0f). Each is a found defect with the component that owns it; a fixed one leaves this list (the lint reports a stale entry), a new one fails tests/spacing-roles.contract.test.mjs. Keys: file, role (table = any step of the role table; H2/H3/H6 = the role the rule names), property, step it resolves to, count. An entry marked optional is found only once a change it waits for lands (it is not stale before).
